verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents first-party full and incremental backups and point-in-time restores, so manual backup and self-serve restore are covered. Nothing in the pack shows automatic scheduled backups or a place to view and configure that schedule; 'regular backups' is framed only as a best practice. Community posts also note backup/restore was historically gated behind enterprise licensing. Missing for 10: documented automatic or scheduled backups, schedule visibility and configuration (UI/CLI), managed-cloud backup defaults, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-serve restores.

support.subject: As a founder, automatic backups run on a schedule I can see and configure, and restores are self-serve
